theme_central: "The great tiding" over which they differ: from observing the signs of creation (the first twenty verses) to the certainty of the Judgment (the last twenty).
sources_note: Two-part (20/20) structure precisely sourced (grokipedia, Heavenly Order): 1-5, 6-16, 17-40.

branches.title: The great tiding
branches.resume: About what do they question one another? About the great tiding over which they differ; soon they will know.

children.t: The great tiding (an-naba) over which they differ

branches.title: Signs of creation
branches.resume: The earth as a cradle, mountains as pegs, creation in pairs, night as rest, seven solid heavens, abundant water.

children.t: Earth as a cradle, mountains as pegs, pairs created, night and sleep
Seven solid heavens, a blazing lamp, abundant water, gardens and crops

branches.title: The Day of Distinction
branches.resume: The Trumpet, heavens opened as gates, mountains carried off like a mirage.

children.t: The Day of Distinction appointed, the Trumpet, mountains carried off

branches.title: Hell
branches.resume: Hell lying in wait, dwelling of the rebellious, neither coolness nor drink except boiling water and pus.

children.t: Hell lying in wait, dwelling of the rebellious, prolonged punishment

branches.title: Success of the pious, closing
branches.resume: Gardens and overflowing cup for the pious; that Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows.

children.t: Success of the pious, gardens, overflowing cup, no vain speech nor lying
The Spirit and the angels in rows; the disbeliever will wish he were dust
